reason: Five thousand rupees up front and then a thousand every month, forever, for something my register and WhatsApp already do for free. I avoid monthly payments, and twelve thousand a year is real money for a small parlour like mine.
objection: Who will help me when the app stops working on a busy Sunday or in Diwali week, with customers waiting and staff not able to bill? And my staff are not all comfortable in English.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, a one-time price or a yearly plan under ₹5,000, a Hindi/local-language option, and a phone number that is actually answered on Sundays.
